segments.name: black
segments.description: flat 0 -- DC reference and a clean segment boundary

segments.name: vlines2_full
segments.description: 2 px vertical grating 0 <-> 1000 cd/m2 -- THE test, level-2 band

segments.name: hlines2_full
segments.description: 2 px horizontal grating 0 <-> 1000 cd/m2 -- same, vertical frequency

segments.name: vlines2_sdr
segments.description: 2 px vertical grating 0 <-> 203 cd/m2 -- the matched in-SDR-range control

segments.name: vlines4_full
segments.description: 4 px vertical grating -- the coarsest AC band (level 3)

segments.name: vlines1_full
segments.description: 1 px vertical grating -- the finest horizontal band (level 1 HL)

segments.name: check1_full
segments.description: 1 px checkerboard -- the finest band of all (level 1 HH)

segments.name: check2_full
segments.description: 2 px checkerboard -- level 2, both directions at once

segments.name: check8_control
segments.description: 8 px checkerboard ON the block grid -- MUST produce NO AC

segments.name: noise
segments.description: fixed-seed per-pixel noise at 1000 cd/m2 -- every sub-band at once

segments.name: step_edges
segments.description: 8 px edges stepping the whole PQ range -- a spread of magnitudes

segments.name: black_end
segments.description: flat 0 -- marks the end of the sequence

note: Achromatic by design: 4:2:0 subsampling would smear a 1 px colour pattern while luma survives a lossless encode exactly. check8_control must decode with NO AC coefficients; if it has any, the picture is not 1:1 on device pixels.
